name: kanban-board
title: Kanban Board
description: A small kanban board with three columns of dark cards, each card carrying a coloured tag, a title, an assignee avatar and a due date. Cards lift while dragged and spring into their new column over a glowing drop line.
use: A small project or pipeline needs a compact draggable board of tasks inside a page.
avoid: Dragging relies on native HTML drag events, so the cards cannot be moved on a touch screen.
a11y: Cards are draggable but not focusable or keyboard-movable, and a move is not announced; the stagger delay is skipped under reduced-motion. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Three narrow columns on a black stage, each headed by a tiny status icon, a bold title and a count on the right. Under them sit rounded dark-grey cards with a small coloured tag pill, a two-line title, a round avatar and a date at the lower right.
behaves: Dragging a card lifts it on a deeper shadow and leaves its slot open. Hovering another column tints that list blue and shows a glowing drop line, and releasing springs the card into the new stack; cards in Launched fade and get struck-through titles.
customise: Pass columns as an array of objects with title, status and cards, and handle drops with onDrop; tag colours, avatars and dates come from each card.
weight: light: Three columns of a few cards using spring and layout transforms around native drag events.
demo: Marketing tasks such as "Draft Q2 nurture email series" across Backlog, In flight and Launched.
issues: Tag labels are very small and low contrast against the dark cards.
There is no keyboard way to pick up or move a card.
polishWhy: Careful card detail and a smooth spring layout; tiny type and mouse-only dragging hold it back.

props.name: onDrop
props.type: (cardId: string, from: ColumnStatus, to: ColumnStatus) => void
